welcome.title: Welcome to Frigate
welcome.description: Let's get your security cameras set up. We'll walk through camera connection, hardware settings, and recording.

camera.title: Add Your First Camera
camera.description: Connect a camera to start monitoring. You can also add more cameras later in Settings.

hwaccel.title: Hardware Acceleration
hwaccel.description: Speed up video decoding with your GPU.
hwaccel.autoNone: No supported video card found. Frigate will decide at startup.
hwaccel.recommendFailed: Hardware detection is unavailable. Frigate will decide at startup.

detector.title: Object Detection
detector.description: Choose the hardware Frigate uses to detect people and objects.
detector.probeFailed: Hardware detection is unavailable. You can configure detection later in Settings.
detector.modelRequired: {{name}} needs a detection model before it can run. Pick a Frigate+ model, or finish setup and add one under Settings > Detection models.

recording.title: Recordings
recording.description: Save video from your cameras so you can watch it later.
recording.storageEstimate: With {{free}} GB free, {{cameras}} camera(s) recording around the clock fills the disk in roughly {{days}} days.
recording.noCameras: You haven't added cameras yet. Recording will apply when you add cameras in Settings.

events.label: Only when something is spotted
events.description: Saves video around people, cars, and other objects Frigate spots. Uses far less disk space.

continuous.label: All the time
continuous.description: Saves video around the clock, so you can go back to any moment. Uses much more disk space.

retentionHint.events: Video of anything Frigate spots is kept this long, then deleted automatically.
retentionHint.continuous: All video is kept this long, then deleted automatically.

complete.title: You're All Set!
complete.description: Your Frigate system is configured. Here's what we set up:
complete.restartNotice: Frigate needs to restart to apply your settings. This takes about 30 seconds.
complete.nextSteps: Next steps: Set up motion masks, zones, and notifications in Settings.

errors.saveFailed: Failed to save configuration. Please try again.
